reason: Names the mailbox of a new profile, which discovery turns into a server; no vocabulary role names a mail address yet. Review when cli-base's vocabulary names one.
Names the IMAP server of a mailbox that discovery cannot find; no vocabulary role names a mail server setting yet. Review when cli-base's vocabulary names one.
Names the login when it is not the full address, which some servers want; no vocabulary role names a mail server setting yet. Review when cli-base's vocabulary names one.
Chooses tls or starttls for the IMAP connection; no vocabulary role names a mail server setting yet. Review when cli-base's vocabulary names one.
Lists the server's short fixed set of folders, which has nothing to filter; the query arrives with `messages list`. Review when messages list ships.

Lists the few profiles on this computer, every one at once by design (WC-ACCT-12), as gcal's session list does; a filter would let a caller narrow it to one and read that as the only profile. Review if a computer commonly holds more profiles than fit one screen.
Adds an IMAP flag or keyword to an email (read, flagged, $Junk); the vocabulary's --add names a chat, and no vocabulary flag names a mail flag yet. Review when cli-base's vocabulary names one.
Takes an IMAP flag or keyword off an email; the vocabulary's --remove names a chat, and no vocabulary flag names a mail flag yet. Review when cli-base's vocabulary names one.

--by rules chooses the mail by the owner's rules (memo's mail delete moved here); the vocabulary's --by groups a list, and no flag names a selection by rules yet. Review when cli-base's vocabulary names one.
